sourceScope: Source and tests in the commit containing this evidence.

nativeValidation.environment: Actual Windows filesystem and dedicated agent-commands.test keyring namespace; PHASE9_QA_PYTHON selects bundled Python for separate-process QA.
nativeChecks: Native register, authenticate, rotate, old-key rejection, new-key acceptance, revoke and revoked rejection.
Private current-user/SYSTEM ACL, permissive Everyone ACL rejection, hardlink rejection, exclusive owner and reacquisition, ancestor directory pinning.
Atomic result replacement, rejection no-replace conflict, digest-bound retirement and preservation of changed ready bytes.
Oversized bounded read retains exclusive handle through rejection/retire; malformed UTF-8 is safely rejected and retired; later valid file remains processable.
Exactly 64 KiB public result projects inside a bounded receipt; receipt and rejection over-limit publication is rejected.

externalProcess.path: Native registration -> production Python signer in separate process -> real CredReadW -> native-private inbox -> native read/HMAC authenticate/retire
externalProcess.substitution: Only signer SERVICE changed to isolated test namespace. No credential passed through argv, environment, stdin or stdout; stdin carries public metadata only.
externalProcess.defaultTestBehavior: This additional process check explicitly skips when PHASE9_QA_PYTHON is unset. It was set for this recorded run.

warnings: Existing scrypt dev-profile package does not match any package.

browserQA.environment: Isolated Chromium + local Vite 9090; actual Data Hub unsupported state and actual AgentCommandPanel/ForegroundAgentCommandRuntime/IndexedDB receipt; native port/auth and read-plan handlers substituted.
coverage: read-plan capability registry and unavailable mutations
browserQA.visualReview: Mobile screenshot inspected; controls and capability rows readable.

checks.environment: Isolated Chromium; blocked IndexedDB keyboard/touch recovery UI.

review.status: All reported correctness findings resolved with focused regression evidence; no outstanding actionable P1/P2 finding reported in final targeted review.
review.method: Independent cross-review of native/signer and runtime/startup/UI, root integration, real filesystem and browser QA.
fixes: Stop initial scan immediately after in-flight work and serialize restart behind owner release.
Reject and retire oversized or malformed-encoding files without disabling valid subsequent requests.
Reject credential-string corpus before any Python vault access or inbox archive publication.
Allow bounded receipt metadata overhead above the 64 KiB public result limit.

observedValidationFailures.failure: Sandboxed Playwright launch returned spawn EPERM.
observedValidationFailures.resolution: Reviewed escalation allowed isolated Chromium; UI QA and rescue verification passed.

limitations: Installed Tauri GUI human-registration to external submission to foreground consumption has not been exercised end to end.
Native tests use actual Windows keyring in a dedicated test service, never production client credentials.
No forced process crash or actual junction creation/reparse attack reproduction.
No Provider/R2 network execution or generated image/output QA.
Phase 9C durable approval/replan/expiry, versioned policy, rolling/outstanding budget and mutations remain unavailable.
Phase 10 MCP SDK/sidecar/spike and Phase 11 background/headless remain unimplemented.
